citation: SokhaPheap open data (2026), derived from COD-AB, WorldPop, Malaria Atlas Project, MoH, OpenStreetMap and DHS — see data/manifest.json

men_smoke_tobacco_pct.label: Men who smoke any type of tobacco

population_lowest_wealth_quintile_pct.label: Population in the lowest wealth quintile

women_distance_is_problem_pct.label: Problems in accessing health care: Distance to health facility

women_overweight_or_obese_pct.label: Women who are overweight or obese according to BMI (>=25.0)

women_smoke_tobacco_pct.label: Women who smoke any type of tobacco

adults_20plus_est.note: WorldPop population × the province's share aged 20+ in COD-PS 2024

dhs.note: Province estimates, ages 15–49. Districts and communes inherit their province's value.

facilities.note: Counts by type inside the area; per 10,000 uses WorldPop 2025

nearest.note: Straight-line km from the COD-AB commune centre point

population.note: WorldPop constrained 100 m, summed over cells whose centre is inside the area

travel.note: Population-weighted mean minutes to the nearest health facility (MAP's 2019 facility list); people where MAP has no value are excluded
